mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.icon, c.color, c.item_count, COALESCE(recent.recent_count, 0) as recent_count, c.create_time FROM favorite_categories c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT category_id, COUNT(1) as recent_count FROM favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_available = 1 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY category_id ) recent ON c.id = recent.category_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.create_time ASC
